notes: Updates are differential: a release now carries a patch beside the full artifact holding only the install files whose contents changed, so a code-only cycle downloads a few megabytes instead of 205. An install on the version the patch was…

What changed is derived by comparing file hashes between builds, never assumed -- a cycle that also replaces the Electron runtime simply produces a bigger patch, and one that deletes a file publishes no patch at all, because the installer…

A patch is verified against the feed's sha256 before it is handed to the installer, and any failure -- HTTP, hash, or a patch that does not name this exact version pair -- downloads the full artifact instead.
The update panel says which it is about to fetch and how big it is, and the downloaded-archive cache now prunes patches as well as full artifacts.
